title: Foundational GEOINT elements
studentMustDo: Distinguish imagery, IMINT, and geospatial information; identify appropriate GEOINT product.

title: Limits of imagery
studentMustDo: Explain what can and cannot be inferred from a single image.

title: Frequency / wavelength / LOS
studentMustDo: Apply the inverse relationship between frequency and wavelength and identify line-of-sight limits.

title: ELINT vs COMINT
studentMustDo: Differentiate ELINT and COMINT given a reporting excerpt.

title: Radar kill chain ordering
studentMustDo: Place radar events in find / fix / track / target / engage / assess order and assess imminence.

title: IR signatures and countermeasures
studentMustDo: Identify exploitable heat signatures and match countermeasures (flares vs chaff).

title: Cyber actor classification
studentMustDo: Classify a cyber incident actor and stage on the kill chain; distinguish cyber threat vs cyber-enabled threat.

title: Information environment dimensions
studentMustDo: Identify physical, informational, and cognitive dimensions in a media inject.

title: Disinfo / misinfo / malinfo
studentMustDo: Tag IO content correctly and distinguish MISO from MILDEC.

title: ISR cycle and PIR → tasking
studentMustDo: Convert a PIR into collection tasks and identify ISR cycle stages.

title: Orbit regimes and uses
studentMustDo: Match LEO / MEO / GEO / polar regimes to mission types.

title: Counterspace effects
studentMustDo: Distinguish kinetic and non-kinetic counterspace and assess escalation implications.
